title: Microsoft 365 admin center: more agent metadata fields in the inventory export
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, export path, Graph call and corrected Graph licensing requirement are supported. It appropriately distinguishes the roadmap's expanded fields from Learn's current column list and reports the conflicting file-format descriptions.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; front matter: changes
claims.claim: The registry page does not name the five roadmap fields as export columns in November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: agent registry inventory export Capabilities Data Sources Actions Created In Created By columns default select columns customize view; read the full agent-registry-overview page, including its export column list.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether the five new fields are exported by default or require selection.
claims.quote: Searched: agent registry inventory export Capabilities Data Sources Actions Created In Created By columns default select columns customize view; read roadmap record and full registry page. Neither states the new fields' default selection.

claims.claim: Global Administrator, AI Administrator, Global Reader, AI Reader, Security Administrator, Security Reader, Reports Reader and User Experience Success Manager can view registry information.

claims.claim: Learn does not specify which roles can run the registry export itself.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 agent registry export permissions role export CSV Excel AI Reader; read agent-roles-perms, registry overview and registry convergence. They document viewing and governance roles, not export-specific permissions.

claims.claim: The Graph Package Management API requires a Microsoft Agent 365 licence.

claims.claim: The registry pages publish no export-specific meter or separate charge in November 2026.

claims.claim: A licence or rate specific to the five new metadata fields is not published.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 agent registry inventory export license pricing meter metadata fields; read registry overview, management licensing, registry convergence and Agent 365 feature-availability excerpts. None specifies an entitlement or rate for those fields.

claims.claim: GET /v1.0/copilot/admin/catalog/packages lists tenant agents for reporting as an alternative to the UI export, not as a file-export operation.
claims.quote: GET https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/copilot/admin/catalog/packages ... By default, the response contains only titles that contain an agent.

claims.claim: List packages returns a collection of agent package objects rather than the registry export file.
claims.quote: If successful, this method returns a 200 OK response code and a collection of copilotPackage objects in the response body.

claims.claim: Learn's registry page describes its Graph agent APIs as preview.
claims.quote: Microsoft Graph API for Agent Registry and Agent Details (preview) ... By using the new Microsoft Graph API endpoints, now in preview

claims.claim: The List packages reference also prints a beta request.
claims.quote: GET https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages

claims.claim: The registry page says its Graph APIs work with the AI Administrator role.
claims.quote: The API works with the AI Admin Role.

claims.claim: The List packages reference does not confirm that the response carries all five roadmap export fields.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Graph copilotPackage capabilities dataSources actions createdBy createdIn metadata inventory export; read List packages, full copilotPackage properties and copilotPackageDetail search excerpts. No five-field export equivalence was stated.

claims.claim: Customize view chooses the columns displayed on the All agents page.
claims.quote: You can customize the agent list on the All agents page. Choose which columns to display.

claims.claim: Learn does not say Customize view determines the export columns.
claims.quote: Searched: agent registry inventory export Capabilities Data Sources Actions Created In Created By columns default select columns customize view; read full registry page. Customize view describes displayed columns, with no stated export linkage.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no switch enabling or disabling the registry export.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 admin center agent inventory export disable enable setting select exported columns; read registry overview and search results. Viva Agent Dashboard export switches concern a different export, not the registry inventory.
claims.fix: Remove the sentence 'Microsoft Learn describes no admin setting that turns the export on or off, and no setting that selects its columns, at the time of writing (November 2026).' The standard requires absent controls named in prose to have null-sided table rows; removing this sentence avoids adding rows.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no setting for selecting the registry export columns.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 admin center agent inventory export disable enable setting select exported columns; read registry overview. It says more than 30 items can be included but gives no export-column selection setting.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft does not document whether the new Data Sources field contains data itself or only its type.
claims.quote: Searched: agent registry inventory export Capabilities Data Sources Actions Created In Created By columns default select columns customize view; read registry overview and roadmap record. Data source filters are explained, but the new export field's contents are not.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk and impact
claims.claim: The export is a read-only report of agent metadata, not an operation that blocks, publishes or modifies agents or changes end-user behaviour.
claims.quote: Export | Exports agents to a CSV file. ... You can export the list of agents to an Excel file. Set the export scope to All agents or Filtered agents for analysis and reporting.

claims.claim: No reviewed source says the new fields change existing behaviour without administrator action.
claims.quote: Searched: agent registry inventory export Capabilities Data Sources Actions Created In Created By columns default select columns customize view; read roadmap record and registry page. Neither describes automatic changes to existing agent or user behaviour.

claims.where: summary; Why it matters; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Running the inventory export is an optional administrator reporting action.
claims.quote: The agent Registry provides agent actions that relate specifically to your tenant's list of agents ... Export ... You can export the list of agents to an Excel file.
